title: Chazal 1985 lumbar PLL failure force (per specimen)

source.authors: Chazal J, Tanguy A, Bourges M, Gaurel G, Escande G, Guillot M, Vanneuville G
source.n: 43 whole ligaments from 18 spines (34 from 12 fresh cadavers <24 h post mortem, 30-80 y, mean 53; 9 SSL/ISL from living surgical subjects)
source.sample: human whole spinal ligaments (ALL, PLL, LF, ISL+SSL, ITL), cervical to lumbar; bone clamped

protocol.summary: Uniaxial tension of entire ligaments, bones held in custom clamps (never the ligament or its insertions), universal joints; constant rate 1 mm/min for loading and relaxation; cadaver ligaments kept in water/alcohol/glycerin solution, surgical ligaments in Ringer and tested <1 h. CSA measured every 2 mm with a palpator, smallest value used for stress; length between nearest bony insertions. Curves sigmoid: point A = end of initial toe (concave) region, point B = end of linear region, point C = apex (rupture).
how_to_simulate: Model the ligament between its bony insertions at the reported resting length and CSA
Apply uniaxial elongation at quasi-static rate (1 mm/min) until rupture
Report force/elongation (or stress/strain) at end of toe region (A), end of linear region (B) and at failure (C)

data.x: mean of specimens above (computed by extractor)

extraction.check_notes: Per-specimen values read from rotated Table 3 (200-dpi render; OCR verified/corrected e.g. LF T6-T7 stress A 2.75, ALL T10-T11 CSA 25). Summary row (mean, SD, min, max) computed by the extractor, not reported by the paper for this region. Cervical specimens excluded from this region test.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
